resources.description:
Restart-Based Ensemble MD Dataset for Diffusion Analysis
This repository contains a molecular dynamics (MD) workflow for diffusion analysis in an aluminum–copper (Al–Cu) system using LAMMPS. The approach is based on a restart-based ensemble method, where multiple short simulations are generated from intermediate states and executed in parallel to improve statistical sampling and computational efficiency.

The repository includes input scripts, restart handling, MSD calculation, and diffusion coefficient extraction. A custom Textual User Interface (TUI) integrated with a Docker environment is provided to manage simulation stages, automate execution, and ensure reproducibility. This framework is designed to accelerate diffusion analysis while maintaining physical consistency through ensemble averaging.
